**The manual points onward rather than finishing the job.** For the remaining path meanings it refers the reader to the Venus D-Bus wiki. Anything not quoted above is not sourced.

**Relay ratings are the real limit, not the logic.** 2 bi-stable relays at 3 A @ 30 VDC or 2 A @ 60 VAC; a separate solid switch rated 70 VDC max battery voltage and 4 A load. Digital outputs are 5 V at 4 mA max — signal pins, not loads. The whole unit is USB-powered and draws under 1 W.
unmappedReports: The bi-stable relays are documented as "0 = A, 1 = B", not off/on. A latching changeover relay has two energised positions and no rest state; `switch-state` is a boolean named Switch and will render position B as "on", which is a category error rather than an inversion. There is no MetricKind for a changeover position., PWM dimming 0–100 % has no CommandKind. See the previous entry.
